- Supa's Cleaning - Commercial Cleaning and Office Cleaning Melbourne – Specialises in commercial and office cleaning with flexible scheduling.
- Clean Group - Commercial Cleaning and Office Cleaning Melbourne – Provides daily, weekly, and customised cleaning services for businesses.
- ACS Commercial Cleaning Melbourne – Triple ISO-certified company offering office, medical, education, hospitality, and industrial cleaning. [acscommercialcleaning.com.au](https://acscommercialcleaning.com.au/commercial-cleaning-melbourne/cbd/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- Beem Cleaners Melbourne – Offers after-hours commercial cleaning, window cleaning, floor care, and waste management for CBD businesses. [www.beemcleaners.com.au](https://www.beemcleaners.com.au/services/commercial-cleaning-melbourne-cbd/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- Spiffy Clean - Commercial and Office Cleaning Services Melbourne – Suitable for offices and commercial spaces with flexible service plans.

Most commercial cleaners in the CBD can provide:
- Daily, weekly, or fortnightly cleaning
- After-hours and weekend cleaning
- Office workstations and common area cleaning
- Kitchen and bathroom sanitisation
- Carpet and hard floor cleaning
- Window cleaning
- End-of-lease and builders cleans
- Waste removal and recycling programs [www.beemcleaners.com.au](https://www.beemcleaners.com.au/services/commercial-cleaning-melbourne-cbd/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

If you're requesting quotes, it's helpful to have the following information ready:
- Office size (m² or number of workstations)
- Number of bathrooms and kitchens
- Desired cleaning frequency
- Preferred cleaning times (business hours or after hours)
- Any specialised requirements (carpet steam cleaning, consumables, window cleaning, etc.)
